summary: Pacira BioSciences, Inc., a Delaware corporation, entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Viatris Inc. and its wholly owned subsidiary Peach Purchaser Sub Inc. on October 8, 2026. Purchaser will commence a cash tender offer for all outstanding Pacira common stock at $36.50 per share, net of withholding taxes and without interest, subject to a majority-of-shares condition and HSR antitrust clearance. Following the offer, Purchaser will merge into Pacira under Delaware DGCL Section 251(h), with no shareholder vote required. The board recommendation and advisor are not specified in the excerpt. Watch regulatory clearance timing and tender conditions for deal closing risk.
